initial_numeric_basis.note: 58 / 1 is an adjustable TWILIGHT numeric choice using the existing melee host default. It does not establish a native range unit; 220/280 are context only, never selection rules.

reference_limit: The official mobile weapon guide discusses cell-based basic attack distances. It does not define NpcAttack.Range's internal scale or any conversion to TWILIGHT host length.
note: Independent of the player distance policy. No max/min, attack selection, spell-override precedence or range checker is introduced. Mixed, missing, zero, excluded or nonpositive owner ranges preserve the existing host input; existing silence fallback remains unchanged.
